summary.text: Dave Wallace is the Republican nominee for Maryland's 2nd Congressional District and owns a kitchen wholesale business. A former NIH cancer researcher, he has sought office repeatedly since 2010, including this seat in 2022 and 2024, and won the June 23, 2026 Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: Wallace graduated from South Carroll High School and earned a B.S. in biology from Salisbury University.
He worked in immunological cancer research at the National Institutes of Health before founding Chesapeake Kitchen Wholesalers in 1981, which Ballotpedia says he still owns.
In 2008 he founded the organization Restore America's Mission.
Wallace ran as a Republican for the Maryland House of Delegates (District 5A) in 2010, and for Maryland's 8th Congressional District in 2012, finishing second in the Republican primary.

In 2014 he was the Republican nominee in the 8th District and lost the general election to Chris Van Hollen, 39.6% to 60.2%, and in 2016 he received 6.1% of the vote in the Republican primary for U.S. Senate in Maryland.
He finished second in the 2022 Republican primary for Maryland's 2nd District (20.2%) and second again in the 2024 primary (23.5%, behind Kim Klacik).
Wallace won the June 23, 2026 Republican primary with 88.9% of the vote over Nnabu Eze.
According to Ballotpedia, Wallace has been married to his wife, Barbara, for more than thirty years and has three children.
